webui.openapi.docs.legend.detail: Each operation can be viewed as documentation or debugged from here: debugging sends requests from your browser (bearerAuth injects the token you enter, kept in memory; webuiSession operations use the session cookie with CSRF-signed mutations like the WebUI itself). Execution requires a reachable backend; mock demo builds are browse-only.
